description: Search Vimeo — equivalent to the search box at the top of every page (vimeo.com/search?q=...). Five result types matching the on-page tabs: video (default), ondemand, people, channel, group. Result cards carry title, URL, duration, author, view count, upload date, and like/comment counts. Supports real sort (relevance/popular/latest/title/name/duration, per-type) and upload-time filtering (video only). Paginates internally up to the limit (max 100); partial=true when results run out. Public search needs no login or browser.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keywords, e.g. "short film". Same behavior as the on-site search box.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Result type: video (default) | ondemand | people | channel | group. Maps to the five tabs on the search results page, each showing a result count.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-100, default 20). Paginates internally; partial=true when results run out.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default relevance). All types: relevance, popular. video/ondemand also: latest, title_asc, title_desc, longest, shortest. channel/group also: latest, name_asc, name_desc. people also: name_asc, name_desc. Invalid type+sort combinations are rejected.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Upload time filter, video type only (default all). all | day (last 24h) | week | month | year. Non-video types only accept all.
